title: Assess Quando? for ADHD users and propose a focus mode
note: Assessment written. Proposal: a narrow, free focus block after the 4 Dec public release. Nothing built.
details: What helps, what gets in the way, the gaps, how other apps serve ADHD users, a focus mode proposal, which updates the business, marketing and market plans need, and how to reach this audience. It needs your yes or no on the focus block, free for everyone, and a first-run choice.
